summary: REQUEST_CHANGES。F5 的 ISL zero-rate/no-deadline horizon loop 已修复并有较强 regression；但 F1 retiring uplink 仍绕过 pre-dequeue geometry/GE/MCS gates。F2 仍有 downlink pending 的 time_step polling、exact GSL deadline 同刻漏结算，以及 GE pre-gate query 未计入 receipt counters。新增两个 GSL queue-gating tests 还可能因未建立 active association 而 false-positive。

findings.summary: FACT: retiring uplink 仅检查 assigned_sat 后直接返回 packet，仍绕过 active 分支的 geometry/GE/MCS availability gates；随后 packet 会先 dequeue 并占住 shared uplink，再由 _transmit 等待恢复或 retirement。
FACT: zero-rate downlink decision 被放入 pending，而 pending 仅按 time_step 重试；此外 _gsl_wait_until 可精确 wake 到 deadline，但 GSL queue sweep 使用 now > deadline，导致 deadline 同刻不结算并丢失后续 exact deadline wake。
FACT: uplink/downlink/_gsl_wait_until 的 pre-dequeue GE queries 未增加 ge_gsl_queries；只有进入 _transmit 后计数。GE 若持续阻止 dequeue，可实际改变调度但 receipt effective.ge 仍为 false。
FACT/INFERENCE: 新增 uplink/downlink GSL queue-gating tests 没有先证明 intended satellite association 已处于 active/retiring；_pick/_servable 都会在无 link 时早退，因此测试可在完全未触发 geometry/GE gate 的情况下通过。

FACT: ISL zero-rate wait now races recovery and every queued TTL/deadline, and at/past horizon avoids rearming zero-time timeouts. Regression covers a no-deadline head plus a later deadline packet, natural end and exact queue area.

FACT/UNVERIFIED: in-scope legacy-style RF parameters, MCS table/formula and integration goldens are internally consistent. Full equivalence to historical legacy source cannot be independently established under the allowed-path contract.

FACT/UNVERIFIED: snapshot residual-service code correctly distinguishes waiting_for_link from transmitting and uses sampled MCS rate only after real start, but the allowed integration test file contains no dedicated snapshot residual regression.

recommendedActions: 统一 UplinkServer._pick 的 active/retiring pre-dequeue geometry、GE、MCS gate；retiring 只保留 assigned_sat drain 限制，不得绕过 availability。
把 zero-rate downlink pending 的恢复与 deadline 改成 certified event race，避免 time_step polling。
修复 queued GSL packet 在 exact deadline wake 时的同刻结算，同时保留 transmission/arrival 在 deadline 边界上的既有 inclusive 语义。
让所有真正影响 service eligibility 的 GE pre-gate query 都进入 receipt attribution，或重新定义并一致实现 query/effective counter 契约。
重写新增 GSL queue-gating tests：先显式断言 active/retiring association，再验证 geometry/GE/zero-rate gate；增加 retiring uplink 与第二个可用 endpoint，验证 shared server 不被 pin。
新增 non-aligned downlink recovery、exact GSL deadline queue-area、all-GE-down receipt regression，并由本地 Agent 运行完整 D1 suite。
